sanskrit_verse: तेनोपसृष्टो लभते न राज्यं राजनन्दनः । कुमारी च न भर्तारम् अपत्यं गर्भम् अङ्गना ॥
transliteration: tenopasṛṣṭo labhate na rājyaṃ rājanandanaḥ / kumārī ca na bhartāram apatyaṃ garbham aṅganā //
sph_interpretive_translation: One who has been violated does not attain kingship; the king's son loses sovereignty. A maiden does not obtain her husband, nor does a woman carry the fruit of her womb.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority is forfeited through violation of dharma
Causation arises from disruption of natural order
Capacity-based responsibility is annulled when agency is removed
Restoration logic demands reversal of corrupted lineage
Consciousness alignment requires purification of violated identity
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent X experiences violation THEN sovereignty rights of X AND descendants SHALL BE nullified UNTIL restoration protocol completes
IF biological continuity is disrupted THEN inheritance AND marital entitlements SHALL BE suspended AUTOMATICALLY
IF purity of origin is compromised THEN claim to rulership OR familial authority SHALL NOT BE VALIDATED by any adjudicating body
supreme_court_application: In cases involving violations that compromise sovereign or familial integrity, the Supreme Court must recognize that legitimacy—whether in governance or procreation—is automatically suspended until restoration protocols realign consciousness and capacity.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Violation disrupts pramāṇa-based causality and severs sequential manifestation (anupūrvaśaḥ). Responsibility lies not in blame but in initiating completion processes that restore original dharmic flow without punitive intent.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate purification rituals to restore violated consciousness
Realign ancestral lineage through Vedic consecration
Suspend claims of authority until integrity is re-established
Engage karmic resolution practices to neutralize causal disruption
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands established: violation disrupts dharma, nullifies claim, and necessitates conscious restoration. There is no punishment—only realignment with Sat.
